nodes.name: The Resonance
nodes.summary: Explore the atlas from its overarching reality into Wish and Hollow, then through planes, galaxies, systems, and worlds. This first survey demonstrates the structure; all locations below the realms are examples awaiting campaign lore.

nodes.name: The Wish
nodes.summary: The higher point of the Resonance. Its planes are gathered here. Descriptions and locations will be added as they become known to the party.

nodes.name: The Hollow
nodes.summary: The lower point of the Resonance. Its planes are gathered here. Descriptions and locations will be added as they become known to the party.

nodes.name: Example Wish plane
nodes.summary: An example plane for exploring the hierarchy. This is not established campaign lore.

nodes.name: Example Hollow plane
nodes.summary: An example plane for exploring the hierarchy. This is not established campaign lore.

nodes.name: Example galaxy
nodes.summary: A galaxy can contain many systems. Published systems appear in their mapped positions; select one to visit its worlds.

nodes.name: Second example galaxy
nodes.summary: A second galaxy demonstrates that a single plane can contain multiple galaxies.

nodes.name: Example Hollow galaxy
nodes.summary: A sample galaxy within the Hollow. No systems have been published here yet.

nodes.name: Example system
nodes.summary: A sample star system. Choose a world on the map to read its published entry.

nodes.name: Distant example system
nodes.summary: A second system demonstrates map navigation. No worlds have been published here yet.

nodes.name: Example world
nodes.summary: A world at the smallest level of this first atlas. Future editions can add the names, places, and histories the party has discovered.

nodes.name: Second example world
nodes.summary: A second world in the same system. This entry is a demonstration, not campaign canon.
